before: A reject of a party's new link that the party had split, and whose first half the party had given another target, dropped the second half around another person's text: the split edge asked only the link's first open edge, which the new target had remade. After a fold, and in Word, the half stayed.
after: A split edge's link decides by any end of its own that only its rejection hides (rejectedLinkEdge), so the half stays around the other person's text, live as after a fold.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format do not change. Only the composed Word file of such a link after the reject changes, and it now equals Word and a fold. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
